def snap(frame):
    pl=None; Ws=[]; frames=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if r0>=60: continue
        if n['color']=='N': pl=(r0,c0,r1,c1)
        elif n['color']=='W': Ws.append((r0,c0,r1,c1,n['pixels']))
        elif n['color'] in 'cG' and n['pixels']>=8: frames.append((n['color'],r0,c0,r1,c1))
    return pl, sorted(Ws), sorted(frames)
print('now:', snap(current_frame))
